The Team: 

Upstart Bank’s Technology Team builds the technology foundation that enables the bank to operate securely, reliably, and at scale. Its scope includes infrastructure, core-banking integration, security, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), and identity management. The team’s squads focus on data and reporting, reconciliation, bank core systems, operating infrastructure, Upstart platform integrations, and consumer products.

As the Director of Privacy and Data Governance Risk at Upstart, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the responsible use of data across the organization. You will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive Privacy and Data Governance Risk Management Program ("the Program") that supports Upstart's mission while aligning with regulatory expectations and industry best practices. This role requires strong cross-functional leadership, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of privacy frameworks, regulatory requirements, and data governance principles. You will work closely with teams across Legal, Compliance, Product, Data Platform, AI/ML, and Information Security to identify, assess, and mitigate privacy and data governance risks across Upstart's products and services.

How you’ll make an impact

• Define and drive the strategy for privacy and data governance risk management aligned with Upstart's business objectives and regulatory obligations.

• Oversee the development of policies, procedures, and processes for data lifecycle management and privacy-by-design.

• Serve as a strategic partner to Product, Data Platform, Information Security and other teams to embed privacy and data governance into product design, business operations, and third-party relationships, including vendor onboarding and renewals and data residency considerations.

• Lead cross-functional working group to ensure governance, accountability, and continuous improvement in privacy risk management.

• Lead a team responsible for the execution of privacy and data governance initiatives, with dotted-line oversight of Privacy Engineering.

• Set team objectives and key results (OKRs), manage performance, and allocate resources effectively to deliver measurable impact.

• Bring clear recommendations, with risks and trade-offs, to senior leaders across the business, driving issues to resolution.

• Act as a spokesperson and subject matter expert for the Privacy and Data Governance  Program in engagements with internal stakeholders and Upstart's partners.

• Prepare and deliver communications, reports, and updates to senior leadership, regulatory bodies, and key external stakeholders as required.

Minimum Qualifications 

• 10+ years of experience in compliance, legal, audit, or risk management within the financial services or fintech industry, with deep expertise in consumer protection regulations. This includes working knowledge of key regulatory frameworks such as GLBA, CCPA, FCRA, UDAAP, federal and state privacy laws, and emerging AI regulations.

• 3–5 years of risk or compliance governance experience at a financial institution, with demonstrated success in scaling frameworks and driving cross-functional alignment.

• Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide risk and compliance programs, influence across levels and functions, and manage complex stakeholder environments.

• Hands-on experience in operationalizing risk management programs, including risk identification, control design, testing and monitoring, training and enablement, and oversight of third-party relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with how predictive models and AI/ML systems use data, and the governance, privacy, and fairness risks that come with them.

• Hands-on experience with consent and data loss prevention tools such as DataGrail and Sentra, and with vendor and contract privacy review.

• Strong people leadership experience, with a track record of building, managing, and developing high-performing teams.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex risk issues into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Current and active certification in Privacy or Information Security (CISA, CISM, CISSP, CIPP, CIPM).

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt  is seeking a Manager of Security Operations, Incident Detection and Response, to bolster and improve the robustness and security of the platform and the entire enterprise. This people-leadership role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring deep expertise in security operations, incident detection and response, AI-driven security automation, and securing multi-tenant SaaS environments. You'll build and lead a high-performing team, own the detection and response technology stack, and serve as the accountable leader for incident response across the entire enterprise, ensuring threats are detected, contained, and remediated quickly from endpoint to cloud to production.

This is a full-time remote position based out of the US (EST Time Zone).

Technologies You’ll Use

Crowdstrike, Okta, Google Workspace, Wiz, Open Source, Notion, JIRA

What You’ll Do

• People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of detection and response engineers and analysts. Set clear goals, manage performance, and grow careers while fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and urgency.

• Hiring & Team Building: Recruit, hire, and onboard top security talent. Define team structure, roles, on-call rotations, and hiring plans to scale the team alongside the business.

• Enterprise Incident Response: Own the incident response program for the entire enterprise, including investigation, containment, eradication, remediation, and post-incident review. Act as incident commander for major security events and coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Communications, and executive leadership.

• Detection Engineering: Build, optimize, and maintain high-fidelity detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and application layers, using threat-informed approaches such as MITRE ATT&CK to close coverage gaps.

• AI-Driven Security Operations: Drive the adoption of AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to automate alert triage, enrichment, investigation, and response. Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities to scale the team, and build detections for threats targeting AI systems and AI usage across the enterprise.

• Multi-Tenant SaaS Security: Design detection and response strategies tailored to a multi-tenant SaaS platform, including tenant isolation, cross-tenant access, and customer data protection. Lead customer-impacting incident response and coordinate customer notifications.

• Security Technology Ownership: Own the security operations technology stack, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud detection and response, and log pipelines. Manage the roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.

• Threat Hunting & Intelligence: Lead proactive threat hunting and integrate threat intelligence to identify and mitigate emerging threats before they impact the business.

• Cross-Team Collaboration: Work directly with engineering, infrastructure, IT, application security, and GRC teams to integrate detection and response practices and remediate risks across build pipelines, runtime environments, and corporate systems.

• Tooling & Automation: Develop and maintain automation, playbooks, and integrations to streamline security processes and provide self-service security tools to the organization.

• Security Standards & Metrics: Implement consistent security controls, monitoring, and alerting across the enterprise. Define and report on key metrics such as mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR), and support compliance requirements.

• Knowledge Sharing: Stay up to date with trends in security operations, incident response, cloud security, and AI security, applying this knowledge to improve the Fivetran platform's security posture.

Skills We’re Looking For

• Security Operations & Incident Response Expertise: Deep expertise in detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents, with a track record of leading enterprise-wide incident response.

• People Management: Proven experience managing, hiring, and developing security teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, and building a strong team culture.

• Multi-Tenant SaaS Experience: Extensive experience securing and responding to incidents in multi-tenant SaaS environments at scale, with a strong understanding of tenant isolation and customer data protection.

• AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience applying AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to security operations to automate detection, triage, and response, and a strong understanding of the risks AI introduces.

• Cloud & Infrastructure Security: Strong experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, and containerized environments, including cloud-native logging and detection.

• Detection & Response Tooling: Proficiency with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, identity, and cloud detection tools, and experience integrating them into automated workflows.

• Technology Ownership: Experience owning a security technology roadmap, including tool selection, budgets, and vendor management.

• Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.

• Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with and educate engineering teams, and to communicate clearly with executives and customers during incidents.

• Curiosity & Urgency: Demonstrates strong curiosity, a sense of urgency, and a hands-on approach to diving deep into complex technical problems to drive timely and effective solutions.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.
We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:
• 
Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.
• 
Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.
• 
Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.
We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.
Requirements
• 
Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.
• 
Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.
• 
Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.
• 
Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.
Bonus:
• 
Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.
• 
Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.
